As a result, $x'(t) = y(t)$ for almost every $t\in (0,T)$. According to \cite[Convergence Theorem p. 60]{aubin1984differential}, it follows that $x'(t) \in -\partial f(x(t))$ for almost every $t\in(0,T)$.
